pages.text: Expanded by Aether: Redux, Deep Aether, Lost Content, Aether Villages and several small add-ons.$(br2)Ride a $(bold)Moa$() or a $(bold)Flying Pig$(). Do not fall off. Feather Falling.
$(bold)Skyroot$() tools first (double drops from Aether blocks), then Holystone, Zanite, and $(bold)Gravitite$() (high jump). Collect $(bold)Ambrosium$() for torches and healing.

Dungeons in order, each needs the key from the last:$(br)$(bold)Slider$() (Bronze) 22,000 HP.$(br)$(bold)Valkyrie Queen$() (Silver) 32,000 HP: Valkyrie armour.$(br)$(bold)Sun Spirit$() (Gold) 42,000 HP: Phoenix armour, fire immune.

$(bold)Deep Aether$(): Skyjade and $(bold)Stratus$() gear, top tier. Its boss is the Eye of the Storm (45,000 HP). $(bold)Lost Content$(): the Aerwhale King (52,000 HP). Treasure Reforging lets you reforge dungeon loot.
